q: What is the carbon footprint of an FRP fibreglass boat?
title: FRP fibreglass boat carbon footprint
short: Glass fibre and polyester or epoxy resin make up most of it, counted by weight bought including offcuts and resin waste. Styrene vapour from open moulding is a health issue, not a greenhouse gas. Add mould shop electricity, then the engine as a separate bought part.
audience: Boat builders making fishing and leisure craft

p: For a powered boat, fuel burned over its life is often larger than building it. Report it separately if a buyer asks.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills, fuel invoices and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so a per unit footprint can be traced back to the documents behind it. Estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
